info.title: StackMate API
info.description: StackMate v1 API — generated from the Hono route table in apps/api/src/hono-app.ts (`app.routes`; run `node scripts/generate-openapi.mjs` to regenerate; `node scripts/check-openapi.mjs` is the CI gate). Endpoints under /api/auth/* that are not listed here are served by the Better Auth handler (sign-up, social sign-in, two-factor enable/disable) — see apps/api/src/modules/identity/better-auth.ts. Money is integer minor units (BDT initial currency); timestamps are UTC ISO-8601; display dates are DD/MM/YYYY. Field-level request/response contracts live in packages/contracts/.

tags.name: General
tags.description: Health, config, and other public endpoints.
